identity.statement: Create a premium abstract artwork for an experimental underground techno identity.
identity.principle: The result should feel like a physical object made from impossible liquid metal, photographed in a dark, controlled environment.

directionSpec.coreMaterial: Sculptural liquid chrome, pearlescent silver, polished metallic fluid, translucent glass-like membranes and smooth flowing geometric surfaces.
directionSpec.light: Iridescent reflections with restrained pale cyan, icy blue, lavender and ultraviolet. Soft white highlights transition into deep charcoal and pure black. The colour should appear as light refracted through the material, not as painted neon.
directionSpec.composition: One striking abstract material formation, with elegant flowing curves, folded liquid surfaces, reflective globes, distorted rings or fluid geometric structures. Combine organic fluidity with precise, minimal geometry. Use deliberate negative space and sophisticated asymmetry.
directionSpec.surfaceQuality: Photorealistic material rendering, exceptionally smooth reflections, subtle micro-texture, physically convincing refraction, deep dimensionality and controlled studio lighting.
directionSpec.artDirection: Contemporary experimental art, underground electronic music, restrained futuristic minimalism, mysterious, cold, hypnotic and unconventional.
directionSpec.colourDiscipline: Silver, pearl, white and charcoal are dominant. Use only one or two subtle iridescent accent colours in each artwork.
directionSpec.exclude: People, faces, bodies, humanoid figures, robots, literal DJ or club imagery, cyberpunk cityscapes, generic sci-fi interfaces, excessive neon, rainbow gradients everywhere, random glitch effects, typography, logos, watermarks, busy collages and cheap-looking CGI.
